scope: Accepted baseline, controlled comparison, negative validation recovery, fixed endpoint diagnosis, four reproduced traces and thirty reference-start controls.
transformations: JSON location strings only; every numeric/bool/null leaf retained. One validation test uses repository-local data instead of a workstation path. Scientific source unchanged.
original_identity_policy: Original and exported identities are distinct. Original checkpoints, full histories and operating reviews remain retained by the coordinator; exports do not replace complete original packages. Paired raw positions/forces and query journals are included byte-identically. Large derived per-query graph summaries are omitted and can be regenerated with the shipped observer.
